theorems.name: Submission.p06_9e0f5043ff_ifl_residue_length_inertia
theorems.statement: ∀ (K E L : Type*) [Field K] [Field E] [Field L] [Algebra K E] [Algebra K L] [Algebra E L] [IsScalarTower K E L] [FiniteDimensional E L] [Algebra.IsSeparable E L] (v : AlgebraicCurve.Place K E) (w : AlgebraicCurve.Place K L) (hw : w.restrict E = v), Module.length v.toValuationSubring (AlgebraicCurve.Place.integralClosureAt L v ⧸ (AlgebraicCurve.Place.fiberCenter L v hw).asIdeal) = (w.inertiaDeg E : ℕ∞)
theorems.natural_summary: Substitute v = w.restrict E. Reduction induces a field isomorphism B/q ≃ w.ResidueField, with surjectivity obtained from the localization description of the place ring. Verify A-linearity using the canonical restrictResidueMap. Finite normalization gives finite residue dimension. Length is preserved by this isomorphism and by the surjection A → κ(v), then equals the finrank defining inertia degree. No principal-divisor hypothesis is used.
